content:
Let \(\theta\) be the central angle of the shaded sector.

Since \(AB\) is a diameter, the upper semicircle has central angle \(180^\circ\). The rays divide it into angles \(40^\circ,\theta,50^\circ,\) and \(30^\circ\). Thus

\[
40^\circ+\theta+50^\circ+30^\circ=180^\circ,
\]

so

\[
\theta=60^\circ.
\]

For a disk of radius \(r\),

\[
P=\frac{\text{sector area}}{\text{disk area}}
=\frac{\frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ}\pi r^2}{\pi r^2}
=\frac16.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac16}
\]
